title: Sailing boat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d94f2b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8e2a12'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6e0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8c98a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail2' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe9b8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d9a95a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M4 80 Q14 74 24 80 T44 80 T64 80 T84 80 T96 80 L96 92 Q84 86 74 92 T54 92 T34 92 T14 92 L4 92 Z' fill='#1f7fa8'/>
  <path d='M4 86 Q16 81 26 86 T46 86 T66 86 T86 86 T96 86 L96 94 Q84 89 74 94 T54 94 T34 94 T14 94 L4 94 Z' fill='#15638a'/>

  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='4' height='54' rx='2' fill='#b8874a'/>

  <!-- main sail -->
  <path d='M52 24 L52 70 Q74 56 76 40 Q74 28 52 24 Z' fill='url(#sail2)' stroke='#f0d79b' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- jib sail -->
  <path d='M46 26 L46 68 Q30 56 28 42 Q32 30 46 26 Z' fill='url(#sail1)' stroke='#fff2d4' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M18 70 L82 70 L72 86 L28 86 Z' fill='url(#hull)' stroke='#f0754a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hull stripe -->
  <path d='M22 76 L78 76 L75 81 L25 81 Z' fill='#ffe08a'/>

  <!-- smiling face on hull -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='74.5' r='2.6' fill='#3ed6a8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='74.5' r='2.6' fill='#3ed6a8'/>
  <path d='M42 78.5 Q50 84 58 78.5' fill='none' stroke='#3ed6a8' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little flag -->
  <path d='M52 22 L52 16 L66 19 L52 23 Z' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
</svg>
